title: What your public player profile shows
description: Everything another player can see when they open your profile, and the four things they can do from it. There is no preview, so you check it by opening somebody else's.
body:
Your profile is public. Anybody signed in to Scoryboard can open it, read your statistics and follow you. Scoryboard has no preview of your own profile, so the way to check what visitors see is to open another player's - every profile is laid out the same way.

See your profile the way others do

  1. Open any player's profile: search for them, or select their name anywhere it appears. What you see there is what other people see when they open yours.

  2. Read the controls across the top of the banner. A visitor gets Back, Chat, Request Payment and Add To Team.

  3. Read what is public: your bio, your ten statistic tiles, your team rank and the teams you are in.

  4. Read the Matches panel. A visitor can switch between Past Matches and Upcoming Matches, but has no Create Match button. That one is only on your own home page.

  5. Select Follow to see that player's activity. The button then reads Unfollow.

What you will see

Your email address and your date of birth are not on your profile. They stay on Profile settings, where only you can read them.

The Views counter is on your own home page and not on the copy other people see.

If it does not work

  • Your statistics are empty to visitors. They are empty to you too. Statistics come from finished matches.
  • Your photo or bio is missing. A visitor sees whatever you have saved. Set them on Profile settings.
  • You cannot find a preview of your own profile. There is not one. Open another player's profile instead; the layout is identical.
  • You cannot find your own profile link. Search your own name in the sidebar and select yourself.
